ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) regions at trailing edges and scattered spots; approximate white-to-black ratio is 0.12:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white patches are mapped to the distal trailing edges and lateral tips. Discrete white punctate blobs and thin linear segments are scattered across the dark medial and proximal fluke areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharply defined vertex; internal angle measured at approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary displays high-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels, clearly isolated from the background water foam.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric profile follows a sigmoidal curve; concave trajectory immediately lateral to the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters on the distal lobe tips and scattered across the central dark pigment regions, consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; prominent diagonal rake marks on the lower right lobe and shorter horizontal streaks on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks across both lobes and irregular pigmentation loss associated with significant trailing edge topography variations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique deep, jagged notch-like formation on the extreme lateral margin of the left lobe trailing edge.
